nodes.name: usb_uart_debug
nodes.description: CP2102N USB-to-UART bridge for ESP32 debug console. VBUS and VREGIN connect to VIN_5V for USB-powered operation. VDD and VIO powered from VIN_5V. TXD/RXD cross-connected to ESP32 UART. DP/DM connect to USB-C data lines. SUSPENDb indicates active USB connection; other GPIO pins unused and left NC per datasheet recommendations.

nodes.name: battery_charger
nodes.description: TP4056 linear Li-ion battery charger powered from VIN_5V. Charges connected battery with standard CC/CV profile. Program charge current via external resistor (not specified in component data, to be set during wiring). Output connects to battery positive terminal. No temperature monitoring or charge status indication pins available in provided component data.

nodes.name: battery_protection
nodes.description: DW01A Li-ion battery protection IC. Monitors VBAT_RAW from charger and provides protected battery output VBAT_PROT. OD (over-discharge) and OC (over-current) control external MOSFETs for protection. CSI for current sensing. VDD powered from battery, VSS to ground. Protection FETs are external and not in component list; downstream wiring must add dual-NFET battery protection switch.

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: ME6211 3.3V LDO regulator. VIN powered from protected battery VBAT_PROT. CE tied to VIN for always-on operation (no shutdown control needed). VOUT provides VCC_3V3 system rail. Input and output need bypass capacitors. This module is the VCC_3V3 distribution hub for all 3.3V loads.

nodes.name: CE
nodes.description: Chip Enable. ME6211C: active high (>=1.0V ON). Tie to VIN for always-on.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ESP32-WROOM-32E WiFi+BLE MCU module. Powered from VCC_3V3. EN pin needs pull-up for normal operation. UART0 (TXD0/RXD0) for debug console, cross-connected to CP2102N. I2C on IO21(SDA)/IO22(SCL) to read BME280. BOOT mode determined by IO0/IO2/IO5 strapping; IO0 must be high for normal boot from Flash. IO15 controls boot message output and needs appropriate strapping. Crystal and antenna matching network internal to module.

nodes.name: sensor_env
nodes.description: BME280 environmental sensor (temperature, humidity, pressure). I2C slave powered from VCC_3V3. CSB tied to VCC to select I2C mode. SDO tied to GND to set I2C address 0x76. I2C pull-up resistors placed in MCU module as bus owner. VDDIO tied to VCC for 3.3V logic level compatibility.
